records.title: Prompt work goes to Prompt Engineer
records.text: Requests to create, compare, improve, version or evaluate system prompts and reusable context bundles should route to prompt_engineer unless the user explicitly selects another role.

records.title: Knowledge-base work goes to Knowledge Growth Analyst
records.text: Requests about knowledge ingestion, provenance, chunking, claims, contradictions, freshness, retrieval quality or knowledge maturity should route to knowledge_growth_analyst.

records.title: External evidence work goes to Research Analyst
records.text: Requests that depend on external facts, market signals, source verification or evidence gaps should route to research_analyst.

records.title: Narrative design goes to Narrative Architect
records.text: Story structure, worldbuilding, character continuity, scenes and narrative alternatives should route to narrative_architect.

records.title: Adversarial review goes to Skeptical Reviewer
records.text: Explicit requests to criticize, red-team, find assumptions, failure modes or counterexamples should route to skeptical_reviewer.

records.title: Generated knowledge is not automatically verified
records.text: Model output may create candidate knowledge, hypotheses, summaries and proposed relations, but promotion to verified knowledge requires applicable evidence and the relevant owner or review gate.

records.title: Prompt changes require version and evaluation
records.text: Material prompt changes must have an explicit prompt id/version, evaluation cases and a review/promotion decision. Agents must not silently replace production instructions.

records.title: Retrieval is context selection, not truth
records.text: A retriever selects candidate context. Retrieved text keeps record identifiers and verification state; retrieval score does not make a claim true.

records.title: MVP hybrid retrieval is inspectable
records.text: The first Zoo RAG uses lexical overlap plus metadata/tag signals. Vector retrieval is introduced only after an evaluation set demonstrates a measurable benefit.

records.title: Prefer one controller and bounded specialists
records.text: Alina remains the conversational controller. Specialists are invoked for bounded tasks; they do not form an unrestricted peer-to-peer swarm.

records.title: Confirmed creative decisions belong to the user
records.text: Agents may propose alternatives and explain consequences, but confirmed Story DNA, world and character decisions are not silently changed by a specialist or model update.

records.title: Routing and answer quality are separate evaluations
records.text: A response may be well written but routed to the wrong specialist. Evaluate routing accuracy, retrieval relevance and final-answer quality as separate dimensions.
